# Refine by Charlotte

> Semi-permanent makeup and lash studio run by Charlotte Louise Anderson, a fully licensed and insured permanent makeup artist, in a private one-to-one studio in Rockbeare, near Exeter, Devon, UK. Treatments: nano hairstroke brows, ombre powder brows and Korean lash lift + tint. Free consultation before every brow treatment.

- Location: Rockbeare, Exeter EX5 2LH, Devon. Serves Exeter, Exmouth, Honiton, Sidmouth, Ottery St Mary, Cullompton and East Devon.
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone 07835 049704, or the enquiry form at https://refinebycharlotte.co.uk/#contact
- Training: trained with award-winning permanent makeup artist Gemma Henderson.
- Microblading is not offered; all brow treatments use a digital machine method.

## Treatments and prices

- [Nano brows](https://refinebycharlotte.co.uk/nano-brows-exeter.html): ultra-fine, hair-like strokes for natural, fuller brows. £295 including a top-up at 6 weeks. Around 3.5 hours.
- [Ombre powder brows](https://refinebycharlotte.co.uk/ombre-powder-brows-exeter.html): soft, borderless shading with a gradient front, as sheer or bold as you like. £250 including a top-up at 6 weeks. Around 3 hours.
- [Eyebrow tattoo overview](https://refinebycharlotte.co.uk/eyebrow-tattoo-exeter.html): how nano and ombre brows compare and which suits you.
- [Korean lash lift + tint](https://refinebycharlotte.co.uk/korean-lash-lift-exeter.html): lifts natural lashes from root to tip with gentle, hydrating formulas. £50. Around 1.5 hours.

## Useful information

- [Brow aftercare and healing, day by day](https://refinebycharlotte.co.uk/aftercare.html)
- [Home page, FAQs and reviews](https://refinebycharlotte.co.uk/)
- Semi-permanent brows typically last 1-3 years; a colour boost every 12-18 months keeps them fresh.
- Brow treatments are not suitable for people taking blood-thinning medication.
